description: The chart illustrates a runtime comparison between different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled with the names of the models being compared, listed in the order: "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude". The vertical axis represents the runtime in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 seconds, marked at intervals of 50 seconds. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a model and consisting of two bars: a green bar labeled "Our Joint Framework" and a blue bar labeled "LLM Models". For "Our Joint Framework", the green bar has a value of 77 seconds, while for the other four models, only the blue bars are visible, with values of 190 seconds for "ChatGPT", 365 seconds for "DeepSeek", 172 seconds for "LLaMA", and 243 seconds for "Claude". The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
